description: Publish a tour as a player-only link (play/pause/speed, optional walking, project details; nothing else) and return it. With `story: true` it is shared as a scroll story instead: a page that opens on the floor plan and, as the visitor scrolls, raises the walls, comes down to where the tour starts and walks it, each room turning from a drawing to its materials as the camera goes in. A tour can have both links. The user is asked to allow it first, and the project must be signed in to the cloud. The link updates on every cloud save. Set the project details with set_project_details first.
name: share_tour
title: Share walkthrough tour
